plans.timingRationale: Provisional nine contacts for 30 learners: one preparation workshop (5 minutes reading, 10 outline, 20 paired practice/feedback, 4 nerves plan, 4 checkpoint, 2 close), then eight roster contacts. Each of the first seven presentation contacts fits four full eight-minute outlines plus about two minutes each for questions/transition and a five-minute opening/close. The last two speakers use the final contact with remaining time for the original questions and educator feedback. The solitary and mirror practices are later. The source’s 5–7 versus eight-minute conflict requires separate editorial review; enrolment and timing trials may reduce/change contacts without adding lessons.
